smell_elimination.justification: The god class smell is completely eliminated. Both _compute_idf_weights and _apply_tfidf_weighting methods are fully removed from CountVectorizer (78 and 44 lines respectively) and relocated to TfidfTransformer where they properly belong. No TF-IDF logic remains in CountVectorizer.

cross_file_coordination.justification: All cross-file impacts are properly handled. The methods are removed from CountVectorizer and added to TfidfTransformer. All call sites in TfidfTransformer are updated from CountVectorizer._compute_idf_weights() to self._compute_idf_weights() and from CountVectorizer._apply_tfidf_weighting() to self._apply_tfidf_weighting(). No orphaned imports, dead code, or dangling references remain.

structural_soundness.justification: The refactoring achieves proper separation of concerns. CountVectorizer now handles only count vectorization, while TfidfTransformer owns all TF-IDF transformation logic. The architectural dependency inversion is eliminated—TfidfTransformer is now self-contained. Methods are changed from static to instance methods, which is appropriate for encapsulation within TfidfTransformer.

code_quality.justification: The code quality is excellent. The methods are moved verbatim with proper documentation, maintaining readability. The conversion from static methods in CountVectorizer to instance methods in TfidfTransformer is clean. Minor deduction for a small formatting inconsistency (extra blank line after _compute_idf_weights definition before the return statement), but this is negligible.

responsibility_identification.justification: The refactoring correctly identifies that TF-IDF computation and weighting are responsibilities of TfidfTransformer, not CountVectorizer. The distinction between count vectorization (CountVectorizer's responsibility) and TF-IDF transformation (TfidfTransformer's responsibility) is properly recognized and enforced.

extraction_quality.justification: Each class now has a single, clear responsibility with properly encapsulated logic. TfidfTransformer owns its transformation logic through instance methods that access self.smooth_idf, self.sublinear_tf, and self.norm. CountVectorizer is restored to handling only count vectorization. No mutable state leaks between classes.

responsibility_extraction_from_countvect.justification: Both _compute_idf_weights (79 lines including docstring) and _apply_tfidf_weighting (44 lines) are completely removed from CountVectorizer. The diff shows complete removal with no TF-IDF logic remaining. CountVectorizer is fully restored to its single responsibility of text-to-count vectorization.

elimination_of_architectural_dependency_.justification: The inappropriate dependency is completely eliminated. TfidfTransformer no longer calls CountVectorizer methods—all references changed from CountVectorizer._compute_idf_weights() and CountVectorizer._apply_tfidf_weighting() to self._compute_idf_weights() and self._apply_tfidf_weighting(). TfidfTransformer is now architecturally self-contained with proper encapsulation of its transformation logic.

aspect_3_judge.summary: This is an exemplary refactoring that completely eliminates the god class smell. The TF-IDF logic is properly relocated from CountVectorizer to TfidfTransformer, restoring single responsibility to both classes and eliminating the architectural dependency inversion. The refactoring is clean, complete, and maintains code quality throughout.
